map.推重比大于 1 意味着什么？: What does a thrust-to-weight ratio above 1 mean?
map.推力大于重力，理论上可垂直加速（如战斗机/火箭），具备超机动与短距起飞能力。客机: Thrust exceeds gravity, so in theory the aircraft can accelerate vertically, as fighters and rockets do, giving super-agility and short takeoff capability. Airliners have a ratio far below 1 and are supported by wing lift rather than thrust.
map.静推重比和飞行中一样吗？: Is the static ratio the same as in flight?
map.不一样。发动机在海平面静态最大推力算出的静推重比最高；随速度/高度推力变化，飞行: No. Static thrust-to-weight from sea-level static maximum engine thrust is the highest; as speed and altitude change the thrust changes, so the in-flight ratio varies. Performance assessment uses the value for the corresponding condition.
